description: Pure Rust record of the verdicts of the Admit Gate: an append-only log with a hash chain per domain and attractors of the accepted shapes. The Base Node hands every verdict to a bounded queue after it is written and one thread records what the queue took.

actions.description: Write one record to a domain that is no domain of judged proposals
Read one page of the verdicts the Base Node recorded for a docking port
Verify every log, its snapshot and its head in the Evidence Ledger

cca.summary: Record of the verdicts of the Admit Gate with attractors of the accepted shapes. The queue takes every verdict it has room for, counts the ones it drops and a killed node loses the queued ones. The health answer shows the gap to the Evidence Ledger. Admit reads only a memo of the writing walls for byte identical text and never takes a permission from the memory.
use_when: an audit needs the record of the judged proposals beside the Evidence Ledger
intent records and graph runs need a search over past shapes
avoid_when: pure stateless agents with no memory needs
